messages.author: 0141b24755b40cf8
messages.subject: change barplot to black and white
parts:
Hi all,

I have a barplot that I have created using ggplot2 with color-coding,
but I would like to make it gray scale.

I tried to use example.plot+scale_colour_grey(end=0,start=1,name=''),
but that doesn't seem to work and I haven't been able to find out how
to do it.

Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks
Wade

Temp<-c("H","H","L","L","M","M")

dat.avg<-c(0.0600000, 0.6078431, 0.5200000, 0.7800000, 0.3000000,

different colors.

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: change barplot to black and white
parts:
Hi Wade,
you are using the wrong function to change the colour. In your example you are using the fill argument to fill the shapes so you must use scale_fill_grey.

This will work:

dat.plot+scale_fill_grey()

Bye
Luciano
